facts.fact: The health ministry's costed Plan Stratégique National de Santé Numérique 2024-2028 states that the national health information system (SNIS) is based on DHIS2, lists DHIS2 as the tool for collecting, sending up and aggregating health data, and schedules a DHIS2 test server and an interoperability framework around it for 2024-2028, with a mid-term review in 2026.

The PSNSN's inventory of software tools in use within the health ministry as at 30 June 2023 lists DHIS2 for the collection, upward transmission and aggregation of health data, and SNISI, carried by the ministry's agency ANTIM, for collecting and sending up health information system data; the plan also records that the national collection system's data is hosted outside Mali.

The PSNSN 2024-2028 sets as a costed specific objective that 75% of health establishments use a harmonised, computerised or shared medical record integrating universal health coverage management by 2028, through continued adaptation and implementation of hospital information system (SIH) solutions at all levels; it names no single product, the target environment being the Environnement Numérique de Santé du Mali (ENSM).
